meta_description: Consulting Color Deltae S.L. — web and app development, publishing, photography and video, digital content and training from the Penedès, Catalonia.
software_edicio_fotografia_i: Software · Publishing · Photo & video · Content · Training
webs_llibres_imatges_i_cursos: Websites, books, images and courses, made with care in the Penedès.
consulting_color_deltae_es_una: Consulting Color Deltae is a company based in the Penedès, Catalonia, that supports cultural projects, organisations and businesses with everything they need to exist and be seen: web and app development, book publishing, photography and video production, digital content and marketing, and training. We build our own products as well as other people's.
e00_1_0_diferencia_imperceptible: ΔE₀₀ < 1.0 · a difference invisible to the human eye
treballem_la_tecnologia_el_text: We work on technology, text, image and outreach together, because a good project needs all of them at once. And we teach how to do it.
disseny_desenvolupament_i: Design, development and maintenance of websites, portals, platforms and mobile apps that are solid and ready to grow.
webs_corporatives_portals_i: Corporate websites, portals and online shops
tot_el_proces_editorial_del: The whole publishing process, from manuscript to bookshop, in print and digital. We do it for authors and institutions, and under our own imprint, Portantveus.
fotografia_professional_i: Professional photography and video production, from the shoot to editing and final retouching, with an obsession for colour.
disseny_continguts_i_estrategia: Design, content and strategy so that what you do is seen, and found when someone looks for it.
formacio_presencial_i_en_linia: In-person and online training on what we do every day, for schools, organisations, companies and individuals.
projectes_propis_i_encarrecs_per: Our own projects and client commissions.
editorial_independent_en_catala: An independent Catalan-language publisher of stories, picture books, early readers and novels by Catalan authors. Every title goes through a process of reading, discussion and revision, and comes with launches, book clubs and stage activities.
en_preparacio_la_colleccio_jaume: . Coming soon: the Jaume Plagumà collection, with unpublished novels by Teresa Juvé, recipient of the Creu de Sant Jordi.
plataforma_per_descobrir_que_fer: A platform for discovering what to do today and this weekend in Catalonia: cultural, sports and outdoor activities, local festivals and family plans, free and paid, on a map and in a list.
cada_activitat_es_situa: Each activity is automatically placed in its town, county and province, so every part of the territory gets its own well-ranked pages. Available in Catalan, Spanish, English and French.
producte_backend_geoespacial: Product, geospatial backend, frontend and SEO
disseny_i_desenvolupament_de_la: Design and development of the web presence of a local dairy company: a clear website to present the company and its products and make it easy for customers and distributors to get in touch.
construim_aplicacions_i_serveis: We build applications and services for companies that need something the market doesn't offer: web platforms, authentication systems, tool integrations and data processing.
experiencia_en_entorns_de_gran: Experience in large-scale environments: Kotlin, Java, Kubernetes, AWS, PostgreSQL and PostGIS.
revisem_cada_text_cada_imatge: We review every text, every image, every screen and every line of code until the difference between what was imagined and what is delivered can no longer be seen.
som_al_penedes_i_treballem_cara_a: We're based in the Penedès and work face to face. We know the area, the language and the people we work with.
fem_servir_les_mateixes_eines_i: We apply the same tools and standards to our own projects as to our clients'. What we recommend, we have tried ourselves.
no_depenem_de_grans_grups: We don't depend on large groups. We choose the projects we believe are worthwhile and answer for them directly.
expliqueu_nos_que_necessiteu: Tell us what you need: a website, an app, a book, a photo shoot, a video, a course or a strategy to get you noticed.
